items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: We used to play concerts quite often in Chicago. ... Played with him in the 20's?

ctx.x: Well Punch Miller, he made a lot of stuff. Yeah, he made a lot of his runs and arpeggios and things like that. And you see poor Punch here. We used to play concerts quite often in Chicago. And Punch used to, you know, too much, too much. Played with him in the 20's?
Huh? Did you play with him in the 20's? Yeah.
